name: Basics
description: A guided AI workflow: brainstorm → build → verify → ship. Plus the full git workflow, issue planning, and documentation actions.

actions.label: Brainstorm
actions.description: Refine the idea before any code.
actions.template: Brainstorm with me: {goal}. Push back on assumptions, suggest 2–3 approaches with tradeoffs, ask follow-ups. No code yet — we're refining the design.

args.name: goal
args.description: What you want to build or solve. Dump as much context as you have — pain points, who it's for, anything you've already tried.

actions.label: Debug
actions.template: Debug: {symptom}. Reproduce, hypothesise, test. Find the root cause before changing anything — don't guess.

args.name: symptom
args.description: What's going wrong. Paste error messages, stack traces, what you tried, what you expected vs got.

actions.label: Verify
actions.description: Run all the project's checks and fix failures.
actions.template: Run the project's checks (lint, typecheck, tests — whatever the README or CLAUDE.md mentions). Fix every failure. Don't claim done until everything passes.

actions.label: Self-review
actions.description: Read your own changes carefully before asking anyone else to.
actions.template: Self-review this branch. Read every modified file, compare against the plan, list anything missing / redundant / sub-par with file:line refs. Then fix it.

actions.label: Triage PR comments
actions.description: Read PR review comments and propose what to do about each, written to .broomy/output/feedback.md.
actions.template:
Read the PR's review comments (`gh pr view --json reviews,comments` + `gh api repos/:owner/:repo/pulls/<n>/comments`). For each comment, propose a response with technical rigor — never blindly agree:
- Agree and implement (sketch the change)
- Disagree because … (cite code or constraints)
- Need clarification (name the question)
- Already addressed in <commit/file:line>

Group by file and write to `.broomy/output/feedback.md`. Don't change any code — 'Address feedback' implements next.

actions.label: Address feedback
actions.description: Implement the triage plan written by 'Triage PR comments'.
actions.template: Read `.broomy/output/feedback.md` — the triaged plan for each PR comment. Implement 'Agree' items; skip 'Disagree' / 'Already addressed'; ask before 'Need clarification'. Apply technical judgment — don't blindly follow the triage if you spot a problem. Reply to disagreements via `gh api` POST to the review-comment reply endpoint.

actions.label: Commit
actions.description: Commit current changes with an AI-written message.
actions.template: Stage relevant files and commit with a clear message that says what changed and why. Don't commit secrets or credentials.

actions.label: Resolve conflicts
actions.description: Resolve merge conflicts cleanly, integrating both sides where appropriate.
actions.template: Resolve merge conflicts from {main}. For each conflict, examine `git log --oneline HEAD...MERGE_HEAD -- <file>` to understand both sides; ask if ambiguous. Integrate both — never silently discard. Run lint/typecheck/tests, then `git commit --no-edit`.

actions.label: Sync changes
actions.description: Pull the latest from main, resolve conflicts, validate, and push.
actions.template:
Sync this branch with {main}:

1. Commit any uncommitted work (skip secrets).
2. `git fetch origin {main}`. Stop if already up to date.
3. Summarise PRs merged into {main} since the merge base via `gh pr list --state merged --base {main} --search "merged:>$(git log -1 --format=%ci <merge-base>)" --limit 20` for conflict context.
4. `git merge origin/{main}`. For each conflict, check `git log HEAD...MERGE_HEAD -- <file>` and the PR context; ask for non-obvious resolutions.
5. Check for semantic conflicts (renamed APIs, removed features) via `git diff origin/{main}...HEAD` cross-referenced with `git diff $(git merge-base HEAD origin/{main})...origin/{main}`.
6. Run lint/typecheck/tests. Fix everything.
7. `git commit --no-edit` if conflicted, then push (set tracking if needed).

actions.label: Push branch
actions.description: Push this branch to the remote, fixing any pre-push hook failures.
actions.template: Push this branch (`git push -u origin HEAD` if no tracking yet). If a pre-push hook rejects it, fix the underlying issue, commit, push again. Repeat until it succeeds. Never bypass with --no-verify.

actions.label: Create PR
actions.description: Prepare the branch, open a PR, and watch CI until it's green.
actions.template:
Create a PR for this branch against {main}:

1. Commit any uncommitted work. Pull/merge {main} and resolve conflicts. Run lint/typecheck/tests. Push (`git push -u origin HEAD` if needed).
2. Check `git diff origin/{main}...HEAD` and `git log origin/{main}..HEAD --oneline`. Check `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`; follow it if present, else write: Background, Design Decisions, Proposed Changes (grouped), Testing. If linked to issue {issueNumber}, FIRST line is `Fixes #{issueNumber}`. Title under 70 chars; check `gh pr list --state merged --limit 5` for style.
3. `gh pr create --title ... --body ...`.
4. Wait for CI (`gh pr checks <n> --watch`). If any check fails: `gh run view <id> --log-failed`, fix, commit, push. Up to 3 fix attempts.

actions.label: Review
actions.description: Code review the current branch and write the result to .broomy/output/review.md.
actions.template:
Review this branch against {main}.

1. `git fetch origin {main}`. Check `git diff origin/{main}...HEAD`, `git log origin/{main}..HEAD --oneline`, and `gh pr view --json number,body` (if a PR exists).
2. If you've reviewed this PR before (look at `gh api repos/:owner/:repo/pulls/<n>/comments` + `gh api user --jq .login`), focus on changes since your last review and whether your prior asks were addressed.
3. Look for correctness, bugs, security, performance, code quality.

EVERY code reference MUST be a markdown link with a repo-relative path: `[src/file.tsx:12-45](src/file.tsx#L12-L45)` — never GitHub URLs.

Write to `.broomy/output/review.md` with sections: Change Summary (grouped, with links), Issues Found, Suggestions, Overall Assessment, Changes Since Your Last Review (only if applicable).

actions.label: Plan issue
actions.description: Read the linked GitHub issue, clarify, then write a plan to .broomy/output/plan.md.
actions.template: Read the issue with `gh issue view {issueNumber}`. Ask any clarifying questions first, then write a plan to `.broomy/output/plan.md`.

actions.label: Screenshot walkthrough
actions.description: Verify the work did the right thing by capturing a screenshot tour of what was built.
actions.template: Build a screenshot walkthrough of what this branch added. Look at `git diff origin/{main}...HEAD`, pick the key UI states / features, capture a screenshot + caption for each, assemble into `.broomy/output/walkthrough.md` with images in `.broomy/output/walkthrough/`. If you can't take screenshots here, say what's needed and stop — don't fake them.

actions.label: Document progress
actions.description: Summarise progress made since the last progress document.
actions.template: Update `.broomy/output/progress.md`. If it exists, read the most recent dated entry to find your last checkpoint; summarise what's happened since (new commits via `git log`, features, bug fixes, decisions, blockers, open items — reference files/PRs/issues). Write a new dated section at the TOP, keep older entries below. If the file doesn't exist, create it with everything on this branch so far.
